context: Riku and Aoi chat about a study app.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (返信/音声/ツール/教材/ダウン) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 英語の学習ツール、使ってるんだ。
lines.en: I'm using an English learning tool.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、音声で発音も学べる?
lines.en: Nice, can you learn pronunciation by audio?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、音声の教材が、すごくいいんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, the audio materials are really good.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 先生に質問したら、返信来るの?
lines.en: If you ask the teacher, do replies come?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: すぐ返信が来て、助かるよ。
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日、アプリがダウンしてなかった?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ダウンしたけど、すぐ戻ったよ。
lines.en: It went down, but recovered quickly.
lines.style: reassuring teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私も、そのツール使ってみようかな!
lines.en: Maybe I'll try that tool too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
